content.body: The French Rifle Grenadier employed a regular infantry rifle and a cup launched rifle grenade of the high explosive fragmentation type. It was an anti-personel weapon and not an anti-armour weapon like the British HEAT greanade was.
content.brief: Special Equipment: Vivien-Bessiere HE Grenade Explosive: 600g (each grenade) Range: 250m Included Weapons: Fusil MAS36 7.5mm Rifle 10 x HE rifle grenades 1 x Combat Knife
content.title: GRENADIER
